sourcePageBasis: capture sequence, checked against surrounding folios
paragraphs: A competent Villain will defend against 3-bets in position with all pocket pairs, suited connectors, suited gappers, and suited aces when stacks are over 200bb. He doesn’t have to flop a set very often to break even, Villain can also put a tremendous amount of pressure on Hero if he isn’t 3-betting enough suited hands. His range will be capped at one pair on many boards and that is a huge liability.
Hero checks. Villain bets $300. Hero calls.

Check-shoving the turn would obviously be the best play if starting aren were $1,000. Villain could bet-call or bet-fold the turn with comb° raws and Hero would be indifferent. However, things change when stacks are $2,000. Hero's turn checking range appears to be K-K -10-10, Bre ay give-ups. Villain is obligated to stab the turn and follow through on the river with a huge range of hands.
